scope: Private binary tabular frozen-model calibration assessment; preserves public benchmark and accepted scientific contracts

rules.required_outcome: Every applicable positive and negative contract case passes on one unchanged candidate
required_backend_evidence: Live PostgreSQL 16 transactions and restricted-role RLS
rules.collection_policy: Proposed nodes below are future targets; replace with actual collected node IDs before reporting results
rules.source_binding: Before/after source and generated-asset hashes, HEAD/dirty provenance, command exits, raw logs, JUnit/browser reports and installed-wheel origins
rules.acceptance_owner: Parent; separate source commit and governance checkpoint
rules.public_activation: Requires independent acceptance and explicit deployment authority

contracts.rule: Every private operation uses verified current account, organization membership and operation authority
positive_cases: Authorized analyst registers own project and reads authorized report
Viewer reads report without gaining write or delete authority
negative_cases: Demo capability and forged organization selector rejected
Expired, wrong-audience and revoked account rejected
Membership revoked after initial check cannot admit or publish work
Owner-only deletion/member operation rejected for analyst/viewer
contracts.required_proof: HTTP decisions and zero unauthorized DB/object/job side effects, including authority changes during controlled waits

contracts.rule: Tenant boundaries apply to DB, foreign keys, queue, storage, public APIs, cache, downloads and exports
positive_cases: Identical data in two tenants retain separate private handles
Authorized range/export request gets only own verified artifact
negative_cases: Foreign asset/job/recipe/result guessed ID is non-disclosing
Cross-tenant foreign key insertion rejected
Public experiment listing and agent result fallbacks never discover private reports
Restricted PostgreSQL runtime role cannot bypass RLS and pooled connection context cannot leak
Logout and organization switch expose no old private payload or rebind work
contracts.required_proof: Two users/two organizations, runtime-role PostgreSQL RLS plus SQLite explicit scoping, object bytes and browser/cache observations

contracts.rule: Uploads stay quarantined until exact content, bounded validation and immutable READY evidence are committed
positive_cases: Valid streamed synthetic CSV has matching raw/canonical/report hashes and READY state
Identical completion replay returns one receipt and validation job
negative_cases: Chunked overrun, false length, quota race, giant field and invalid format rejected
Disconnected transfer and crash cannot expose incomplete assets
Different content under same upload conflicts
Stale validator cannot promote or remove current owner bytes
Required scanner/storage/sandbox failure blocks readiness
contracts.required_proof: Actual byte accounting, DB reservation release exactly once, reopened state and owned-object/staging visibility

contracts.rule: Dataset schema, class/role identity and label access are explicit, immutable and isolated
positive_cases: Exact supported dtype/missing/class mapping preserved through canonicalization
Declared versus verified training provenance remains distinct
One-class role qualification and valid metric availability preserved
negative_cases: Invalid UTF-8, quoting, duplicate normalized headers, labels, coercion and row width rejected
Record/entity overlap prevents role leakage; legitimate equal feature vectors not silently discarded
Final labels never enter inference, selectors, tools, DOM or logs
Label-dependent acquisition changes fail the nested-prefix guard
Changed mapping/schema requires a new version
contracts.required_proof: Raw and canonical identities, exact ordered role membership, canary labels and negative inspection of every handoff

contracts.rule: Only approved self-contained frozen graphs execute inside a tested resource and access sandbox
positive_cases: Approved numeric and proven mixed preprocessing/model profile executes with no refit
Runtime/profile/version manifest matches installed isolated runner
negative_cases: Pickle/joblib/custom Python/native ops and unapproved ONNX domains rejected before loading
External tensors, nested graph violations and oversized dimensions rejected without allocation escape
CPU/RAM/wall/PID limits terminate excessive models and reap children
Model/parser cannot read host files, DB or secrets or use network
Hosted readiness rejects missing sandbox or test-only identity/runtime injection
contracts.required_proof: Actual platform isolation tests and process exit/resource evidence; structural ONNX validation alone is insufficient

contracts.rule: Probability outputs bind exact schema, class columns, row order, missing behavior and conversion parity
positive_cases: Original trusted fixture parity meets frozen tolerances
Natural/injected missingness and unseen-category policy work in the approved graph
Batch 1/16/512 and repeat inference preserve row probabilities
negative_cases: Swapped classes/rows/columns, wrong row count and hard labels cannot score
NaN/inf/out-of-range/unnormalized/map or sequence outputs fail typed validation
Unknown missing representation and unproven graph profile stay unsupported
Fixture produced only by uploaded graph is not independent parity provenance
contracts.required_proof: Original fixture and output hashes, per-batch original class/row binding and no permissive output coercion

contracts.rule: Scientific assessment preserves frozen inference, pre-evaluation recipe, nested labels, paired masks and truthful fallbacks
positive_cases: Source and target calibration independently fit original frozen-model probabilities
Masks precede acquisition and paired methods share final rows/masks
Decision threshold/loss and metrics agree with independent analytic fixtures
Raw/source/target comparison allows distinct calibrated map IDs while binding each side's exact fitted parameters and condition
negative_cases: Preprocessor/predictor refit, source-stacked target fitting and outcome-guided recipe changes rejected
Budget-zero/one-class/nonconverged fits preserve fallback and exact consumption without redraw
Budget-zero target fit is unattempted and does not inflate fit-failure counts
Raw failure yields null metrics and unavailable comparisons
Hardcoded Bank evaluation row count or feature/sentinel policy rejected for business data
Comparison with mismatched predictor, evaluation rows, masks, acquisition records, costs or referenced map parameters is unavailable
Unqualified/adverse outcomes and reused evaluation warnings cannot be omitted
contracts.required_proof: Analytic numerical assertions, immutable model bytes/state, evaluator-only outcomes and persisted context/diagnostic readback

contracts.rule: Admission and replay accept the authorized immutable recipe once within current quota
positive_cases: Managed HTTP job executes its exact submitted recipe
Same key/body returns one durable job and original receipt
Intentional rerun retains a distinct execution audit
negative_cases: Concurrent last-slot requests never exceed two organization jobs
Same key/different recipe conflicts before creating a duplicate
Accepted-then-lost response/reload/retry cannot create a second job
Replays under revoked or another principal do not grant old access
Changed/expired/deleting asset cannot enter a new accepted recipe
contracts.required_proof: Separate processes/connections on both backends, real accepted HTTP response loss, stored recipe/audit and exact job identity

contracts.rule: Current worker authority decides publication and terminal state atomically, including recovery and cancellation
positive_cases: Normal and post-rename crash completion have identical result/audit/hash relationships
Valid distinct executions of identical content both persist
negative_cases: Expired/replaced fence or attempt cannot heartbeat/publish/complete
Claim/cancel/recovery and authority-revocation schedules retain winning terminal decision
Conflicting content or failed conditional transition rolls back every result/audit/event/publication mutation
Live CLI/upload/worker owners survive unrelated cleanup
Unknown private job kind cannot fall through to benchmark baseline
contracts.required_proof: Controlled barriers/crash points and complete DB/file/object assertions after reopen on both supported backends

contracts.rule: Private artifacts, logs, retention, deletion and restores preserve confidentiality and owned lineage
positive_cases: Authorized exact manifest download verifies current bytes
Deletion receipt separates access revocation/live-copy removal/backup expiry
Backup restore revalidates incomplete publication and asset states
negative_cases: Native/provider/parser errors never expose labels, raw cells, paths, credentials or stack traces
Hash mismatch and missing blob cannot serve purported verified evidence
Pinned/live assets cannot be swept by age or unsafe reference count
Delete/export/recovery races cannot remove another owner's data
Private assistant, telemetry, localStorage and public endpoints reveal no canary private input
contracts.required_proof: Storage fault injection, content/secret canaries, exact deleted version inventory and measured restore drill

contracts.rule: Forward migrations, source/package and supported old databases share one verified contract
positive_cases: Fresh/current head and upgrades from accepted 0008/actual supported Gate 6 schema preserve demo jobs/sessions/results
Installed wheel outside checkout includes private modules/migrations and passes CLI/API/import smoke
negative_cases: Applied historical migration bytes cannot change
Missing runtime/RLS/object/sandbox resources block readiness
Source checkout imports cannot masquerade as installed-wheel proof
No old demo session receives private authority through backfill
contracts.required_proof: Actual PostgreSQL and SQLite fresh/upgrade data readback, wheel origin/hash checks and unchanged historical revision hashes

contracts.rule: Browser and acceptance evidence represent actual private state and one unchanged supported candidate
positive_cases: Keyboard/mobile/reduced-motion onboarding and evidence tables work with actual API/worker state
Generated/served asset graph and source/report digests match frozen candidate
Manual BYO works without provider access and public Gate 5 behavior remains
negative_cases: Fake upload progress, Bank substitution, missing/null/fallback metrics and fabricated success rejected
Offline/expired authority/org switch/stale response cannot overwrite or transfer current intent
Missing reports/required skips/failed commands/wrong source never produce PASS
Unsupported graph/task/feature shows explicit unavailable state rather than fake upload capability
contracts.required_proof: Real private end-to-end browser assertions, visual/accessibility checks, actual collected nodes/logs/JUnit and parent independent source binding
